itinerary.description: Fly into Prague and check into your hotel. Explore the historic city center at leisure.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Tokyo
itinerary.description: Fly into Tokyo (Narita or Haneda). Transfer to your hotel and explore the Shinjuku or Shibuya neighborhood.

itinerary.title: Tokyo Highlights
itinerary.description: Visit Shibuya Crossing, Harajuku, and the Meiji Shrine. Enjoy Tokyo's world-class dining scene.

itinerary.title: Tokyo Day Trip or Ginza
itinerary.description: Explore the Tsukiji Outer Market, Asakusa's Senso-ji Temple, or luxury shopping in Ginza.

itinerary.title: Shinkansen to Kyoto
itinerary.description: Board the bullet train to Kyoto. Check in and visit the Fushimi Inari Shrine or Gion district.

itinerary.description: Visit Kinkaku-ji (Golden Pavilion), Arashiyama Bamboo Grove, and the Tenryu-ji garden.

itinerary.title: Kyoto UNESCO Heritage Sites
itinerary.description: Explore Nijo Castle, Kiyomizudera Temple, and the traditional Higashiyama district.

itinerary.title: Shinkansen to Osaka
itinerary.description: Travel by bullet train to Osaka. Visit Osaka Castle and explore the Dotonbori entertainment district.

itinerary.title: Departure from Osaka
itinerary.description: Transfer to Kansai International Airport for your return flight home.
